value.description: Geometric sans, semibold-bold, mixed case, centred (bbox centre x 0.49-0.51). Greeting word settles at 43% of frame width (F14); name line 52% wide, glyph height 16% of frame height (F30). Two-colour: first word navy-black (darkest pixel #000000 at F30), product name brand blue #0C5AC4; the opening word runs navy to #1170EE. Face looks like Plus Jakarta Sans or similar (inferred).
Same sans, regular-medium, white on #0966F6, centred; glyph height 13.6% (F60), then a single word at 12.2% (F75). Words are added on a cut, one every 4-6 frames.

Same sans, regular, navy with the last words in a lighter blue, centred; 9.7% glyph height (F100), then a full sentence at 6.7% (F121, 57% of frame width). Each new word arrives pale and darkens over 3-4 frames.

The product's own UI text: grey-black #141414 sans at 3-4% of frame height in wide shots; placeholder prompt in a monospaced face; product name inside typed prompts in brand blue; answers in small body text (about 2% of frame height).
In the two prompt close-ups (15.3-17.8 s, 19.25-21.67 s) the field is shot at about 6% glyph height so typing reads like a headline; the camera follows the caret.

Benefit sentence 6.4% glyph height, centred, navy, words fade up one by one; wordmark lower case, bold, cyan #2FBAFA, about 40% of width with a small navy tagline under it; call to action 3.6% and closing line 5% glyph height, centred, held still.

evidence: full-frame text bounding boxes measured at F14, F30, F60, F75, F100, F121, F650, F700, F720, F745; cross-checked against speech-text.json screenText boxes (full frame; box heights run 5-10% above glyph height: name 0.172, blue line 0.151, single word 0.148, audience 0.106, sentence 0.069-0.072, closing sentence 0.079, call to action 0.048, last line 0.053)

composition.value: Everything is centred on the frame's vertical axis; type sits on the horizontal centre line (OCR boxes of the kinetic lines span y 0.42-0.59, box centres x 0.50-0.51). Kinetic type uses 37-57% of frame width; the hero word starts at well over 100% and settles at 43%. Wide UI shots show the assistant panel at about 70% of frame width with large white margins; punch-ins take the prompt field to about 1.8x (prompt line OCR box height 0.037 wide -> 0.064-0.066 close; title 0.044 -> 0.064-0.080) and the send button macro to about 7x, framed off-centre so the field's rounded corner leads the eye to the button. The headline-size prompts (15.3-17.8 s, 19.25-21.67 s) have field boxes 0.09-0.15 of frame height and run off the left edge (OCR boxes at x=0) while the camera follows the caret. Light pale-blue squares (about 2% of frame width, #D1E6FB-ish) float in the margins of UI shots. Crop: the earlier analysis copy was falsely cropped to x 308-1278 by the static-bands detector; source.json crop is now null and OCR, sheets and motion.json were re-run on the full 1280x720 frame. Only a grey watermark sits top left.
evidence: speech-text.json screenText 5.5-9.5 and 15.5-21.5 box heights and x (full frame)

materials.value: Flat digital: white and near-white grounds, one saturated blue ground, a soft out-of-focus blue light (a large blurred radial blob) at an edge or corner, a pale sky-blue linear gradient behind the prompt close-ups, and a purple-to-lilac vertical-band shimmer as the loading placeholder. UI is a light, rounded, thin-bordered interface. No texture, grain or 3D.

lighting.value: No lit scene. Light is a graphic element: a blurred blue blob that drifts at the left edge during the open (F0-F16), sweeps right off the product name (F17-F26), and becomes a fixed corner glow at bottom right on the closing grounds (25.7-31.5 s).

styleSummary: Clean light SaaS launch film: centred geometric sans on white and one saturated blue, a soft blue light as the only ornament, and real interface shot at reading scale with hard punch-ins. Cool palette (white, navy, two blues, cyan) with one purple accent reserved for the loading shimmer.
